kpi_rationale: Growth, order book, margin and qualification KPIs pass. Operating cash flow failed in three of six years and was negative in the first half of FY2027, working-capital days rose to 304, and the FY2026 capex plan does not reconcile with the cash-flow record. Those cash items keep the health reading at watch rather than a clean pass.
summary_rationale: The franchise is real: qualification takes 30 to 48 months, customer relationships run over ten years, an eight-year price agreement covers the MHI relationship, and operating margin rose from 23% to 37% in five years. Cash conversion is the constraint. Cumulative operating cash flow over FY2021 to FY2026 was negative against cumulative net profit of ₹329 crore, and working capital absorbs most of the earnings. The verdict is conditional on cash turning positive while growth continues.
